alerts.reason: I forecast June-quarter revenue growth above -5% as the comparison reaches the period of depressed hydrocarbon demand (C). Service and equipment orders each fell 18% (B). As fewer orders convert to sales, I expect a September-quarter decline of at least 5%. Turbomachinery was the only segment cited as offsetting lower activity elsewhere (A).

The August 2020 launch of PGA TOUR 2K21 contributed to the $562.2 million annual bookings increase. Earlier titles saw bookings fall after their launch year (B). I expect the June quarter to stay above -5% year over year, then the August launch anniversary to make the September comparison hard enough for reported net revenue to fall at least 5%. The filing gives no title-level quarterly revenue, so the size of the effect is uncertain.

Higher third-party module volume supports a June-quarter forecast above -5% year over year. Three Sun Streams project sales also helped drive March's 51% net sales increase, and substantially all GA Solar 4 construction ended in 2020 (A, B). I forecast a September-quarter decline of at least 5% if module sales cannot replace the prior year's project revenue. Project timing is the main uncertainty.
